FALLBACK of hbm_hc_tail_child_k4: same netlist; clock = pre-placed symmetric equal-delay spine (clock_spine.tcl OT_SPINE_SYM 1, leaves <= 16 flops / 60 um bin, measured leaf padding) from a clk pin at the S-face centre, against the k3 hold stall (outlier long-wire leaf, all-flop spread 89.5 TT / 79.9 FF). | SAFE checklist (HBM-ELEM13/HC-TAIL 10-21, rebuilt after the k3 --cts gate: TT placement -300 / CTS SS -363 at the Sinkhorn sticky fault flop, cone = steady quotient Q3 segment + range compare + 16-way s_bad OR from 1,938 cut flops; FF hold stall -39.7 (5 R2R) after 24.6k hold buffers): 1 pins PASS (RTL pin flop + 2nd stage on every data pin, output pin flops; rst_n reset_landing 2 then ot_rst_relay 3 regions + kept leaf) | 2 reach PASS by plan: square 388.8 um < 405, every pin->core hop registered; post-GRT 405 by gate | 3 fanout PASS: clone limit 24, native32 census on mapped + retained netlist | 4 depth FIXED: no multicycle; Sinkhorn steady step now 16 single-period segments with the quotient output cut QO (y / range registered, SQO 1 via SKP 2, SDIV 17): the fault OR and the st write start at registers; tail TPIPE 1 unchanged (k3b same tail: TT -22 pre-repair) | 5 storage PASS: no runtime-indexed flop array > 2 kb (the 6,144-b mix store is in the HC root, SRAM under SAFE 1) | 6 floorplan PASS: no macros, util ~0.48, square, one full std-cell band | 7 clock: ONE root clk, no derived clock; boundary pin-flop spread <= 80 by --cts gate (k3: 28.7/28.6) | 8 reset PASS: only control/valid flops reset (data OT_FP_DATA_NORST), regional relay; schedule static, no backpressure; child L 989 (+493 edges over L 496): root TAILC emit offset TE 2 -> 495 (root xr4).
